text:
{ "entries": [
  {
    "name_han": "太上老君养生诀",
    "logic_thesis": "This text proves that longevity is not a gift of fate but a reversible consequence of disordering breath, spirit, and desire. If the body is treated as a micro-heaven whose qi can be conserved and re-ordered, premature decay is shown to be a failure of method rather than an inevitable law. Health is therefore an engineered state: quiet the heart, regulate qi, and the lifespan extends as a natural product of that re-ordering.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Heaven and earth endure because they do not exhaust themselves through restless striving. 2) Man declines early because desire, speech, and irregular breath leak jing-qi. 3) Therefore the same non-exhaustion principle applied to the body should restore duration. 4) Concrete means—breathing rules, timing of rest, restraint of emotions—are instruments of that non-exhaustion. 5) Conclusion: cultivation of quiet and regulated qi is sufficient proof that lifespan can be lengthened by method.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Map a chart's weak organs or depleted day-master to the text's priority of 'stop leakage first' before any aggressive tonification. 2) In daily practice, fix one breathing window (e.g., dawn) and treat missed practice as qi-leak, not moral failure. 3) When reading BaZi for health, treat excessive Fire/Wood output (speech, anger, overwork) as the primary drain the text targets. 4) Use the text's sequence: calm spirit → regulate breath → only then seek strength. 5) Advise clients: lifestyle re-order precedes talisman or remedy.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike the abstract metaphysics of 阴符经, this text is a how-to of conservation, not a theory of stealing the mechanism of heaven. It differs from 养性延命录 by being shorter, more pedagogical, and framed as Laojun's decree rather than a medical anthology. Its logic is prophylactic: stop loss, do not yet refine elixir."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太清导引养生经",
    "logic_thesis": "The text proves that bodily form is not passive matter but a movable conduit of qi; intentional posture and stretch can redirect stagnant flows that mere stillness cannot. Longevity therefore requires both quiet and directed motion: daoyin is the missing middle term between medicine and pure meditation. If qi is blocked in channels, movement is the logical first remedy, not more sitting.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Qi must circulate; blockage produces disease and short life. 2) Stillness alone may deepen blockage if channels are already stiff. 3) Directed stretch, breath, and sequence open pathways. 4) Opening pathways restores the body's self-repair. 5) Therefore systematic daoyin is a causal intervention on lifespan, not mere exercise. 6) Conclusion: form-training is qi-training.",
    "logic_practice": "1) For BaZi charts with Earth excess or Water stuck (damp, heaviness), prescribe morning daoyin before any herbal or symbolic remedy. 2) Link specific stretches to organ correspondences of the weak stems/branches (e.g., Metal-lung sequences for dry Metal charts). 3) Treat 'guiding' as intentional: breath leads, limbs follow—never random gym motion. 4) Use seasonal timing: spring stretch Wood, autumn refine Metal. 5) In cultivation logs, record post-daoyin pulse/clarity as evidence of channel open.",
    "logic_compare": "Compared with pure 胎息经 breath-work, this text insists the body must move to free qi. Unlike later neidan's internal-only focus, it keeps a physical, early-Daoist, gymnastic causality. It is less precept-based than 天师教戒 and more biomechanical than 黄庭's visualization anatomy."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太上三五正一盟威箓",
    "logic_thesis": "This corpus proves that spiritual authority and protective efficacy are not private experiences but contractual statuses established by register, oath, and correct lineage. Without the盟威 structure, ritual power lacks legal standing in the celestial bureaucracy; with it, the adept's commands bind because they rest on sealed agreement. Orthodoxy is therefore a logic of credential, not only of virtue.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Heaven administers through ranks, names, and documents. 2) Humans act on that order only if properly registered and sworn. 3) The 箓 encodes identity, powers, and limits of the adept. 4) Alliance-威 is the binding force that makes spirits obey. 5) Unregistered practice is thus logically unauthorized and unsafe. 6) Conclusion: transmission + register = operative legitimacy.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi counseling that touches ritual, first ask lineage/register status before inventing rites. 2) Treat 'name and office' of spirits as fixed roles—do not reassign casually. 3) Use the logic of credential when a chart shows heavy Authority (官杀): formal structure protects better than improvisation. 4) For clients seeking protection, prioritize clear vow and boundary over ornate technique. 5) Map 三五 numerology to timing choices only after the ethical contract is clear.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike 玉枢宝经's universal prayer-logic, this text is institutional and initiatory. It differs from 太平经's cosmic reform by focusing on individual priestly status. Versus 化胡经's polemical mission narrative, 盟威箓 is bureaucratic-operational: who may command, and by what seal."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "正一法文天师教戒科经",
    "logic_thesis": "The text proves that communal order and personal destiny are jointly governed by precept: violation of 戒 is not only moral failure but a causal source of calamity, disease, and lost protection. Correct teaching (教) works because it aligns human conduct with the administrative will of Heaven; discipline is therefore soteriological technology, not social ornament. Salvation is argued as obedience that restores cosmic reciprocity.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Heaven responds to human conduct with blessing or misfortune. 2) Precepts specify the conduct that keeps reciprocity intact. 3) Breaking precepts severs the covenant and invites spirits of disorder. 4) Community enforcement multiplies individual virtue into social peace. 5) Therefore teaching-and-discipline is the primary cure for age-wide chaos. 6) Conclusion: law of conduct precedes magical technique.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Before reading 'remedy' in a BaZi chart, audit lifestyle precepts (truthfulness, sexual restraint, non-harm) as first variables. 2) For charts with strong 食伤 and weak 印, teach speech-and-desire limits as luck repair. 3) Use confession/repentance logic when clients cycle the same disaster year after year. 4) Structure group practice (family, temple) with clear 科 rules, not only personal meditation. 5) Treat 'bad luck' as possible covenant breach before blaming stems alone.",
    "logic_compare": "More legalistic than 养生诀's hygiene, and more communal than 存神炼气铭's solitary gas-spirit work. Unlike 想尔注, which moralizes Laozi verse by verse, this text is a code of Tianshi discipline. It differs from 太平经 by centering institutional 科戒 over millenarian scripture breadth."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太平经",
    "logic_thesis": "Taiping Jing proves that cosmic peace (太平) is a measurable state produced when heaven, earth, and humanity re-enter mutual non-injury and free circulation of life-force and wealth. Political disorder, disease, and natural disaster are argued as one system failure: blocked communication, hoarded resources, and inverted hierarchies. Therefore reform of text, governance, and personal virtue is a single causal project—not three separate domains.",
    "logic_chain": "1) The cosmos thrives when qi, information, and goods circulate without blockage. 2) Human greed, false teaching, and bad rule block circulation. 3) Blockage appears as famine, plague, and rebellion—same pattern at different scales. 4) Correct books and teachers reopen the channel between Heaven and people. 5) Individual longevity and empire-wide 太平 share one logic of openness and reciprocity. 6) Conclusion: salvation is systemic rebalancing, not private escape alone.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Read BaZi 'blocked' patterns (印 too heavy, 财 locked, 官 inverted) as micro-太平 failures of circulation. 2) Advise giving/teaching/flow of resources when charts show pathological accumulation. 3) Use the text's triad: correct knowledge → correct conduct → correct timing of action. 4) In community rituals, prioritize reconciliation and shared merit over exclusive power. 5) Treat epidemic or family crisis years as calls to reopen emotional and material flow, not only to 'ward off ghosts.'",
    "logic_compare": "Broader and more political than 养生-only texts; more utopian-reformist than 正一's priestly discipline alone. Unlike later neidan's body-as-furnace focus, 太平经 keeps society and cosmos as primary scales. 太平经钞 extracts this logic in condensed form; the full 经 argues through massive dialogue and redundancy to overwhelm doubt."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太平经钞",
    "logic_thesis": "As a digest, the Chao proves that the 太平 system can be reduced to portable axioms without losing its causal claim: open the channels of virtue, speech, and qi, and both body and realm stabilize. Compression itself is an argument—that the long scripture's force lives in a few recurring laws, not in endless narrative. Selection is therefore a logic of essence over encyclopedic persuasion.",
    "logic_chain": "1) The full 太平经 contains repetitive proofs of one circulation-reciprocity thesis. 2) A reliable extract can isolate those proofs. 3) Portable axioms enable teaching under constraint of time and literacy. 4) If the axioms hold, practice need not wait for complete canon mastery. 5) Conclusion: condensed transmission preserves soteriological causality when fidelity of selection is high.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Use the Chao as a checklist of principles when full 太平经 is unavailable for study. 2) Teach clients three axioms only: don't block, don't hoard, don't invert hierarchy of Heaven-Earth-Man. 3) In BaZi yearly advice, phrase luck as 'restore flow' matching the digest's clarity. 4) Compare any modern summary against Chao to test whether essence or trivia was kept. 5) Memorize key 钞 passages as daily orientation before complex neidan work.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike the full 太平经, it sacrifices dialogic scale for usability. It differs from 广圣义, which expands a short classic, by doing the opposite operation: contraction. Versus 教戒科经, it remains doctrinal-cosmic rather than purely disciplinary."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太上黄庭中景经",
    "logic_thesis": "This text proves that the body contains a complete divine bureaucracy of 'palaces' and spirits whose presence, once visualized and nourished, constitutes the real structure of health and immortality. External ritual and crude breath are incomplete unless the inner landscape is known and inhabited; form is a map of gods. Longevity is therefore argued as successful residence of spirit within form, not mere biochemical endurance.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Each organ-region houses named spirits and functions as a court. 2) Disease and death follow when spirits depart or starve. 3) Visualization, recitation, and pure qi feed and retain them. 4) Retained spirits re-order the body into a micro-heaven. 5) Therefore knowing the 中景 map is necessary for durable cultivation. 6) Conclusion: anatomy of spirit precedes advanced elixir work.",
    "logic_practice": "1) For BaZi weak organs (e.g., weak Earth spleen, weak Water kidney), pair stem/branch diagnosis with corresponding 黄庭 palace visualization. 2) Practice short daily 存思 of the relevant palace rather than only general 'calm.' 3) When charts show scattered 神 (many 食伤, restless Fire), use the text's logic: call spirits home before seeking power. 4) Recite or silently name palace spirits to stabilize attention. 5) Never force sexual or aggressive alchemy without prior inner-landscape literacy.",
    "logic_compare": "More imaginal-anatomical than 导引养生经's physical daoyin and than 胎息经's pure breath. Differs from 存神炼气铭 by being scriptural-poetic and palace-dense rather than short inscription-style method. Versus 入药镜, it maps the house; the latter times the drug."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "存神炼气铭",
    "logic_thesis": "The inscription proves that spirit and qi are co-dependent variables: lose spirit and qi scatters; deplete qi and spirit cannot stay. Immortality practice therefore collapses to one dual operation—hold the spirit still while refining the qi pure—rather than a catalog of many techniques. Brevity itself argues that the method is simple in principle and absolute in requirement.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Spirit is the master; qi is the servant and vehicle. 2) If spirit wanders, qi has no governor and leaks. 3) If qi is coarse or exhausted, spirit has no seat. 4) Hence simultaneous 存神 and 炼气 is the minimal sufficient practice. 5) Ancillary arts fail when this dual core is missing. 6) Conclusion: dual cultivation of stillness-of-spirit and purity-of-qi is the efficient cause of extended life.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In daily practice, measure sessions by 'spirit stayed / qi warmed,' not minutes alone. 2) For BaZi day-masters weak with strong output, prioritize 存神 (attention hygiene) over stimulants. 3) For strong day-masters with clogged 印, emphasize gentle 炼气 over more mental effort. 4) When illness years hit, return to this dual core before complex protocols. 5) Teach: eyes, breath, and intent as one triangle implementing the铭.",
    "logic_compare": "Shorter and more method-pure than 养性延命录's anthology. Less landscape-detailed than 黄庭, less sexual-alchemical than some Zhong-Lü materials. Differs from 了心经 by working psychophysical qi, not only cognitive cessation of mind-objects."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "养性延命录",
    "logic_thesis": "Tao Hongjing's compilation proves that extending life is an empirical, multi-source craft: diet, sleep, sex, daoyin, breath, and seasonal living are convergent causes that can be ranked and combined. No single secret replaces the accumulation of correct micro-habits; nature (性) is preserved by eliminating the many small deaths of excess. Longevity is argued as engineering of daily causality.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Lifespan shortens by identifiable excesses and deficits. 2) Ancients recorded partial remedies across schools. 3) Collecting and ordering them yields a practical system. 4) System works because each factor is causal, not symbolic only. 5) Therefore anthology + discrimination beats sectarian monopoly. 6) Conclusion: cultivate nature by managing the full lifestyle matrix.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Build a BaZi health plan as a matrix: sleep, food, sex, motion, emotion—score each against chart weaknesses. 2) Prefer subtracting excess (alcohol, late nights, rage) before adding exotic practice. 3) Season-adjust advice using the text's calendrical hygiene. 4) For 食伤-heavy charts, regulate speech and stimulation as lifespan tech. 5) Treat the record as experimental: test one variable for 49 days, then next.",
    "logic_compare": "More medical-encyclopedic than Laojun's short 养生诀, more secular-hygienic than 盟威箓's ritual law. Unlike 钟吕传道集's staged internal alchemy curriculum, it stays mostly pre-neidan and multi-modal. It differs from 胎息经 by refusing breath monopoly."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "太上老君说了心经",
    "logic_thesis": "The text proves that bondage is cognitive: the mind manufactures objects, attachments, and identities that then appear as external fate. 'Finishing the mind' (了心) is liberation because when mind-objects cease to bind, neither demon nor destiny has a handle. Cultivation's highest lever is therefore insight into mind's constructive activity, not only qi manipulation.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Suffering and obstruction arise where mind clings and discriminates. 2) Clinging is not forced by heaven; it is mind's habit. 3) Seeing this habit through dissolves its necessity. 4) Dissolved habit leaves spirit free and responsive. 5) Free spirit no longer generates self-inflicted calamity. 6) Conclusion: awakening to mind's emptiness of fixed objects is the root soteriology.",
    "logic_practice": "1) When BaZi shows repeating disaster patterns, first audit the mental story that re-enacts them. 2) Use short 了心 checks: 'Who is anxious? What object is grasped?' before ritual fixes. 3) For strong 比劫/ego charts, prioritize mind-seeing over more competitive striving. 4) Pair with breath only after a moment of cognitive release. 5) Teach clients: luck changes when the interpreter of luck changes.",
    "logic_compare": "Closer to Buddhist-flavored mind doctrine than 阴符经's strategy of heaven-man theft. Differs from 存神炼气铭 by targeting cognitive objects more than qi purity. Unlike 想尔注's moral commandments, 了心经 argues freedom through epistemic shift, not mainly through precept."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "黄帝阴符经",
    "logic_thesis": "Yinfu Jing proves that the universe runs on a stealable, concealable mechanism: the sage who observes and appropriates the same generative-destructive processes that drive heaven and earth gains power without opposing the Dao. Human agency is legitimate when it mirrors cosmic timing and predation-as-transformation; blindness to the mechanism is the only true weakness. Strategy and spirituality thus share one logic of insight into process.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Heaven and earth have a hidden operating pattern (阴符). 2) The myriad things are produced and slain by that pattern. 3) The sage's eye can read and enact the pattern. 4) Enacting it 'steals' the creative-killing function for cultivation and governance. 5) Those who only moralize without reading mechanism remain prey. 6) Conclusion: profound observation of process equals power.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In BaZi, treat luck pillars as 阴符 windows: act with the season of the chart, not against it. 2) Map 'kill and give life' to 官杀 and 印: pressure transforms into resource when timed. 3) Practice observing one natural process daily (rise/fall of energy) as training for reading fate. 4) For 七杀 charts, reframe killing qi as usable mechanism, not pure doom. 5) Conceal intent: strategic quiet beats loud force when mechanism is understood.",
    "logic_compare": "More martial-strategic and cryptic than hygienic 养生 texts. Unlike 道德经's soft yielding emphasis in many readings, 阴符 stresses predatory insight and timing. Differs from 入药镜 by speaking cosmic strategy more than staged drug-fire details of neidan."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "入药镜",
    "logic_thesis": "Ruyao Jing proves that internal alchemy can be compressed into a mirror-like set of correspondences: when to gather the 'medicine,' how fire phases rise and fall, and what errors scatter the elixir. The body-time complex is argued as a precise craft of intake and cookery; without correct timing and measure, effort is counterfeit. Clarity of formula is itself the soteriological claim.",
    "logic_chain": "1) True medicine arises at specific internal-temporal conditions. 2) Fire (intent/breath intensity) must match the stage. 3) Wrong timing or excess fire damages jing and scatters qi. 4) Correct sequence crystallizes the elixir. 5) A 'mirror' text exists to check practice against known marks. 6) Conclusion: verified stage-markers make immortality a disciplined technology.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Never force 'gather medicine' in BaZi death-phase years without checking vitality signs. 2) Use the text's markers (warmth, stillness, light) as pass/fail for sessions. 3) For weak day-masters, keep fire low (gentle intent); for stagnant strong charts, carefully raise circulation—not aggression. 4) Log lunar/clock timing against subjective medicine arising. 5) Treat sexual loss and anger as breaking the mirror—immediate stop and repair.",
    "logic_compare": "More formulaic and stage-sensitive than 阴符经's abstract strategy. Shorter and denser than 钟吕传道集's dialogue curriculum. Differs from 胎息经 by emphasizing drug-and-fire language over fetal breathing alone."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "胎息经",
    "logic_thesis": "The text proves that ordinary mouth-nose breathing is a fallen, leaky mode, while return to embryonic respiration—qi circulating without coarse panting—restores the prenatal condition of life. Breath is the master variable: master the subtle breath and the spirit stabilizes; fail it and all other arts rest on a cracked foundation. Immortality is argued as reversion of respiratory ontology.",
    "logic_chain": "1) The fetus lives by internal qi without external gasping. 2) Birth establishes leaky external breathing and gradual decline. 3) Training can reverse breathing toward embryonic subtlety. 4) Subtle breath retains jing and calms spirit. 5) Retention enables higher spirit-work and longevity. 6) Conclusion: fetal breathing is the root technique of reversion.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Build practice on lengthening, softening, and eventually 'closing' coarse breath before complex visualizations. 2) For BaZi 气虚 patterns (weak 印, exhausted 劫), prioritize 胎息 over intense movement. 3) Use lower-abdomen awareness as the 'womb' seat of breath. 4) Stop practice if breath becomes forced—force is anti-embryonic. 5) Pair sleep hygiene with 胎息: night repair as prenatal return.",
    "logic_compare": "More mono-causal (breath-rooted) than 养性延命录's multi-factor hygiene. Less palace-visualization than 黄庭, less cosmological strategy than 阴符. Unlike 存神炼气铭's dual slogan, 胎息经 elaborates the breath pole as the royal road."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "秘传正阳真人灵宝毕法",
    "logic_thesis": "Lingbao Bifa proves that the complete path can be ordered as a graded curriculum from human to immortal, with each stage having prerequisites, methods, and verification signs. Random eclecticism fails because higher 'fires' applied to unprepared 'medicine' destroy the vessel; sequence is therefore not pedagogy alone but physical-spiritual safety logic. Completion (毕) means finishing the ladder, not collecting techniques.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Transformation of body-spirit has discrete stages. 2) Each stage produces a new capacity and a new vulnerability. 3) Skipping stages misapplies method to unready material. 4) A complete method text must list order, time, and proofs. 5) Zhong-Lü style sequencing integrates earlier arts under one ladder. 6) Conclusion: graded completion is the rational structure of immortality practice.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Diagnose the client's/current stage before recommending 入药 or advanced fire. 2) Use BaZi vitality and age cycles as rough stage-gates (don't force late-stage work on depleted charts). 3) Demand verification signs before 'promotion' in practice. 4) Keep a written ladder: hygiene → breath → gather → cook → transcend. 5) When stuck, step down one stage rather than adding exotic methods.",
    "logic_compare": "More systematically staged than 入药镜's compact mirror and than 胎息经's single root. Closely related to 钟吕传道集 but more 'method manual' than dialogue. Differs from early Tianshi 科戒 by being alchemical-interior rather than communal-legal."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "钟吕传道集",
    "logic_thesis": "This dialogue proves that true transmission occurs when doubts are systematically dismantled and the disciple's worldview is rebuilt around yin-yang, five phases, and the body as crucible. Zhong-Lü authority rests on reasoned Q&A: alchemy is teachable because it answers why each step must be so. Oral-style dialectic is thus argued as the proper form of high Daoist pedagogy.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Disciples fail from partial hearing and wrong questions. 2) Masters must expose false paths (mere quietism, crude sexual arts, empty ritual). 3) Correct cosmology (Heaven-Earth-Man, time-fire) grounds correct practice. 4) Dialogue tests understanding before empowering method. 5) Shared Zhong-Lü framework unifies scattered techniques. 6) Conclusion: reasoned transmission prevents fatal error better than secret slogans alone.",
    "logic_practice": "1) Teach BaZi/neidan by question-driven correction, not monologue dumps. 2) Explicitly refute the client's likely false path (only meditation / only talismans / only supplements). 3) Ground every timing advice in yin-yang five-phase causality visible in the chart. 4) Require the student to restate the 'why' of a method before practicing. 5) Use the text's topics as a syllabus checklist for complete training.",
    "logic_compare": "Dialogical and comprehensive versus 入药镜's terse formulas and 毕法's stepwise manual tone. More neidan-interior than 太平经's social utopia. Differs from 广圣义 by building a practice cosmology rather than commentarial expansion of Laozi verse."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "老子想尔注",
    "logic_thesis": "Xiang'er proves that the Daodejing can be read as a concrete code of life-extension and communal orthodoxy: 'Dao' becomes a personal-celestial power that rewards purity, restraint, and correct worship while punishing deviation. Philosophical ambiguity is deliberately closed into actionable 戒; commentary is thus a political-soteriological instrument. Longevity and social order are argued as fruits of obeying a moralized Laozi.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Laozi's verses can be interpreted many ways. 2) The Xiang'er lineage selects readings that bind conduct and ritual. 3) Binding readings produce clear rewards and punishments from Dao. 4) Community that follows them gains life and stability. 5) Rival readings that license license or empty speculation are rejected. 6) Conclusion: orthopractic commentary is the true activation of the classic.",
    "logic_practice": "1) When citing 道德经 in BaZi counsel, prefer actionable virtue (less desire, less cunning speech) over aesthetic paradox. 2) Link chart disasters to specific conduct breaches the Xiang'er would name. 3) Use 'Dao watches' as a discipline frame for clients who only want techniques. 4) Prioritize sexual and dietary restraint as textual, not merely medical, duty. 5) Build family rules from commentarial precepts, not only from luck pillars.",
    "logic_compare": "More moralizing and Tianshi-aligned than philosophical Laozi readings and than 关尹子's speculative mysticism. Differs from 广圣义 by being early, terse, and disciplinary rather than Tang-era encyclopedic exegesis. Unlike 化胡经, its aim is internal community rule, not external religious competition narrative."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "老子化胡经",
    "logic_thesis": "Huahu Jing proves (within its polemical frame) that Daoist authority is historically prior and universally missionizing: Laozi's westward transformation of the barbarians explains rival teachings as derivative pedagogy. Religious legitimacy is argued through narrative of origin and conversion, not only through inner cultivation results. Hierarchy of teachings is therefore a historical-logical claim.",
    "logic_chain": "1) If Laozi is the source sage who civilizes all directions, later foreign doctrines are partial echoes. 2) Narrative of 化胡 supplies that source relation. 3) Source relation implies superior completeness of Daoist method. 4) Communities use the narrative to justify ranking and conversion. 5) Contested historicity does not cancel the text's internal logic of priority. 6) Conclusion: mission myth functions as an argument for doctrinal supremacy.",
    "logic_practice": "1) In comparative religion work, separate the text's polemical logic from empirical history before teaching. 2) Use the 'skillful means for different peoples' idea carefully: adapt teaching form without contempt. 3) For BaZi cross-cultural clients, prioritize universal cultivation laws over identity contests. 4) Study the text to understand how Daoist institutions once argued authority—then avoid crude supremacy in modern practice. 5) Extract only the usable kernel: one Dao, many pedagogical languages.",
    "logic_compare": "Unlike 想尔注's inward precept commentary, 化胡经 is outward and competitive. Differs from 玉枢宝经's inclusive salvific prayer by ranking traditions. Versus 钟吕传道集, it barely cares about internal stage-craft; its battlefield is origin story and legitimacy."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "道德真经广圣义",
    "logic_thesis": "Guangshengyi proves that the Daodejing's authority expands, rather than dilutes, when layered with imperial, commentarial, and scholastic meanings: a short classic can govern politics, cosmology, and cultivation if exegesis is vast enough. Breadth of interpretation is argued as fidelity to an inexhaustible source text. Sacred sense is therefore cumulative and institutional, not only private insight.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Laozi is brief and polyvalent. 2) Sage-kings and masters have drawn successive valid layers. 3) Collecting those layers (广) serves both state and salvation. 4) A 'holy meaning' frame unifies layers under orthodox Daoism. 5) Readers gain a map from politics down to body practice. 6) Conclusion: expansive commentary is a technology of totalizing the classic's use.",
    "logic_practice": "1) When a BaZi or life problem seems only personal, check political-social layers of Dao (timing of office, speech, non-contention). 2) Use multi-level reading: one verse → body, family, state analogies. 3) Avoid reducing Laozi to a single self-help slogan; hold several valid applications. 4) Teach advanced students to cite commentarial lineages, not only gut feel. 5) For cultivation, pull 无为 as both mental non-forcing and strategic non-overreach in luck use.",
    "logic_compare": "Opposite operation to 太平经钞: expansion versus compression. More scholastic-imperial than 想尔注's early disciplinary bite. Differs from 关尹子 by remaining tethered to Laozi's chapter structure rather than free speculative chapters."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "关尹子",
    "logic_thesis": "Guan Yinzi proves that ultimate reality is approachable through radical fluidity: things, selves, and distinctions are provisional transformations within one Dao, so liberation is cognitive-ontological flexibility rather than accumulation of fixed techniques. Paradox and image dissolve rigid causality just enough to free the sage's response. Wisdom is argued as unblocked transformation-awareness.",
    "logic_chain": "1) Fixed names and dualisms freeze the mind. 2) The world itself is endless transformation without hard edges. 3) Matching mind to that fluidity ends fearful grasping. 4) Unbound mind acts with spontaneous appropriateness. 5) Techniques serve only if they don't re-freeze the mind into dogma. 6) Conclusion: metaphysical fluidity is practical freedom.",
    "logic_practice": "1) When BaZi readings become fatalistic prisons, use 关尹子 logic to reopen multiple skillful responses. 2) Practice seeing one event under several five-phase descriptions without panic. 3) For rigid 官杀 charts/personalities, prescribe contemplations on transformation and non-fixity. 4) Drop methods that have become identity armor. 5) Alternate precision practice (breath, stages) with periods of open, imageless resting.",
    "logic_compare": "More free-speculative and literary-philosophical than Tianshi codes and than Zhong-Lü stage manuals. Differs from 了心经 by broader ontological play, not only mind-object cessation. Unlike 阴符经's hard strategic mechanism, 关尹子 softens mechanism into metamorphosis."
  },
  {
    "name_han": "九天应元雷声普化天尊玉枢宝经",

thought: The user wants me to extract logical reasoning from 20 classical Daoist/BaZi-related texts and return structured JSON. This is a scholarly extraction task - I need to produce logic_thesis, logic_chain...I can help you extract logical reasoning from these classical Daoist texts. Let me start by searching for the specific texts to get accurate information and schemas for any tools we might need.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that longevity is not a gift of fate but a reversible consequence of disordering breath, spirit, and desire. If the body is treated as a micro-heaven whose qi can be conserved and re-ordered, premature decay is shown to be a failure of method rather than an inevitable law. Health is therefore an engineered state: quiet the heart, regulate qi, and the lifespan extends as a natural product of that re-ordering.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven and earth endure because they do not exhaust themselves through restless striving. 2) Man declines early because desire, speech, and irregular breath leak jing-qi. 3) Therefore the same non-exhaustion principle applied to the body should restore duration. 4) Concrete means—breathing rules, timing of rest, restraint of emotions—are instruments of that non-exhaustion. 5) Conclusion: cultivation of quiet and regulated qi is sufficient proof that lifespan can be lengthened by method.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map a chart's weak organs or depleted day-master to the text's priority of 'stop leakage first' before any aggressive tonification. 2) In daily practice, fix one breathing window (e.g., dawn) and treat missed practice as qi-leak, not moral failure. 3) When reading BaZi for health, treat excessive Fire/Wood output (speech, anger, overwork) as the primary drain the text targets. 4) Use the text's sequence: calm spirit → regulate breath → only then seek strength. 5) Advise clients: lifestyle re-order precedes talisman or remedy.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike the abstract metaphysics of 阴符经, this text is a how-to of conservation, not a theory of stealing the mechanism of heaven. It differs from 养性延命录 by being shorter, more pedagogical, and framed as Laojun's decree rather than a medical anthology. Its logic is prophylactic: stop loss, do not yet refine elixir.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that bodily form is not passive matter but a movable conduit of qi; intentional posture and stretch can redirect stagnant flows that mere stillness cannot. Longevity therefore requires both quiet and directed motion: daoyin is the missing middle term between medicine and pure meditation. If qi is blocked in channels, movement is the logical first remedy, not more sitting.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Qi must circulate; blockage produces disease and short life. 2) Stillness alone may deepen blockage if channels are already stiff. 3) Directed stretch, breath, and sequence open pathways. 4) Opening pathways restores the body's self-repair. 5) Therefore systematic daoyin is a causal intervention on lifespan, not mere exercise. 6) Conclusion: form-training is qi-training.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For BaZi charts with Earth excess or Water stuck (damp, heaviness), prescribe morning daoyin before any herbal or symbolic remedy. 2) Link specific stretches to organ correspondences of the weak stems/branches (e.g., Metal-lung sequences for dry Metal charts). 3) Treat 'guiding' as intentional: breath leads, limbs follow—never random gym motion. 4) Use seasonal timing: spring stretch Wood, autumn refine Metal. 5) In cultivation logs, record post-daoyin pulse/clarity as evidence of channel open.
entries.logic_compare: Compared with pure 胎息经 breath-work, this text insists the body must move to free qi. Unlike later neidan's internal-only focus, it keeps a physical, early-Daoist, gymnastic causality. It is less precept-based than 天师教戒 and more biomechanical than 黄庭's visualization anatomy.

entries.logic_thesis: This corpus proves that spiritual authority and protective efficacy are not private experiences but contractual statuses established by register, oath, and correct lineage. Without the盟威 structure, ritual power lacks legal standing in the celestial bureaucracy; with it, the adept's commands bind because they rest on sealed agreement. Orthodoxy is therefore a logic of credential, not only of virtue.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven administers through ranks, names, and documents. 2) Humans act on that order only if properly registered and sworn. 3) The 箓 encodes identity, powers, and limits of the adept. 4) Alliance-威 is the binding force that makes spirits obey. 5) Unregistered practice is thus logically unauthorized and unsafe. 6) Conclusion: transmission + register = operative legitimacy.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi counseling that touches ritual, first ask lineage/register status before inventing rites. 2) Treat 'name and office' of spirits as fixed roles—do not reassign casually. 3) Use the logic of credential when a chart shows heavy Authority (官杀): formal structure protects better than improvisation. 4) For clients seeking protection, prioritize clear vow and boundary over ornate technique. 5) Map 三五 numerology to timing choices only after the ethical contract is clear.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 玉枢宝经's universal prayer-logic, this text is institutional and initiatory. It differs from 太平经's cosmic reform by focusing on individual priestly status. Versus 化胡经's polemical mission narrative, 盟威箓 is bureaucratic-operational: who may command, and by what seal.

entries.name_han: 正一法文天师教戒科经
entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that communal order and personal destiny are jointly governed by precept: violation of 戒 is not only moral failure but a causal source of calamity, disease, and lost protection. Correct teaching (教) works because it aligns human conduct with the administrative will of Heaven; discipline is therefore soteriological technology, not social ornament. Salvation is argued as obedience that restores cosmic reciprocity.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven responds to human conduct with blessing or misfortune. 2) Precepts specify the conduct that keeps reciprocity intact. 3) Breaking precepts severs the covenant and invites spirits of disorder. 4) Community enforcement multiplies individual virtue into social peace. 5) Therefore teaching-and-discipline is the primary cure for age-wide chaos. 6) Conclusion: law of conduct precedes magical technique.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Before reading 'remedy' in a BaZi chart, audit lifestyle precepts (truthfulness, sexual restraint, non-harm) as first variables. 2) For charts with strong 食伤 and weak 印, teach speech-and-desire limits as luck repair. 3) Use confession/repentance logic when clients cycle the same disaster year after year. 4) Structure group practice (family, temple) with clear 科 rules, not only personal meditation. 5) Treat 'bad luck' as possible covenant breach before blaming stems alone.
entries.logic_compare: More legalistic than 养生诀's hygiene, and more communal than 存神炼气铭's solitary gas-spirit work. Unlike 想尔注, which moralizes Laozi verse by verse, this text is a code of Tianshi discipline. It differs from 太平经 by centering institutional 科戒 over millenarian scripture breadth.

entries.logic_thesis: Taiping Jing proves that cosmic peace (太平) is a measurable state produced when heaven, earth, and humanity re-enter mutual non-injury and free circulation of life-force and wealth. Political disorder, disease, and natural disaster are argued as one system failure: blocked communication, hoarded resources, and inverted hierarchies. Therefore reform of text, governance, and personal virtue is a single causal project—not three separate domains.
entries.logic_chain: 1) The cosmos thrives when qi, information, and goods circulate without blockage. 2) Human greed, false teaching, and bad rule block circulation. 3) Blockage appears as famine, plague, and rebellion—same pattern at different scales. 4) Correct books and teachers reopen the channel between Heaven and people. 5) Individual longevity and empire-wide 太平 share one logic of openness and reciprocity. 6) Conclusion: salvation is systemic rebalancing, not private escape alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read BaZi 'blocked' patterns (印 too heavy, 财 locked, 官 inverted) as micro-太平 failures of circulation. 2) Advise giving/teaching/flow of resources when charts show pathological accumulation. 3) Use the text's triad: correct knowledge → correct conduct → correct timing of action. 4) In community rituals, prioritize reconciliation and shared merit over exclusive power. 5) Treat epidemic or family crisis years as calls to reopen emotional and material flow, not only to 'ward off ghosts.'
entries.logic_compare: Broader and more political than 养生-only texts; more utopian-reformist than 正一's priestly discipline alone. Unlike later neidan's body-as-furnace focus, 太平经 keeps society and cosmos as primary scales. 太平经钞 extracts this logic in condensed form; the full 经 argues through massive dialogue and redundancy to overwhelm doubt.

entries.logic_thesis: As a digest, the Chao proves that the 太平 system can be reduced to portable axioms without losing its causal claim: open the channels of virtue, speech, and qi, and both body and realm stabilize. Compression itself is an argument—that the long scripture's force lives in a few recurring laws, not in endless narrative. Selection is therefore a logic of essence over encyclopedic persuasion.
entries.logic_chain: 1) The full 太平经 contains repetitive proofs of one circulation-reciprocity thesis. 2) A reliable extract can isolate those proofs. 3) Portable axioms enable teaching under constraint of time and literacy. 4) If the axioms hold, practice need not wait for complete canon mastery. 5) Conclusion: condensed transmission preserves soteriological causality when fidelity of selection is high.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Use the Chao as a checklist of principles when full 太平经 is unavailable for study. 2) Teach clients three axioms only: don't block, don't hoard, don't invert hierarchy of Heaven-Earth-Man. 3) In BaZi yearly advice, phrase luck as 'restore flow' matching the digest's clarity. 4) Compare any modern summary against Chao to test whether essence or trivia was kept. 5) Memorize key 钞 passages as daily orientation before complex neidan work.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike the full 太平经, it sacrifices dialogic scale for usability. It differs from 广圣义, which expands a short classic, by doing the opposite operation: contraction. Versus 教戒科经, it remains doctrinal-cosmic rather than purely disciplinary.

entries.logic_thesis: This text proves that the body contains a complete divine bureaucracy of 'palaces' and spirits whose presence, once visualized and nourished, constitutes the real structure of health and immortality. External ritual and crude breath are incomplete unless the inner landscape is known and inhabited; form is a map of gods. Longevity is therefore argued as successful residence of spirit within form, not mere biochemical endurance.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Each organ-region houses named spirits and functions as a court. 2) Disease and death follow when spirits depart or starve. 3) Visualization, recitation, and pure qi feed and retain them. 4) Retained spirits re-order the body into a micro-heaven. 5) Therefore knowing the 中景 map is necessary for durable cultivation. 6) Conclusion: anatomy of spirit precedes advanced elixir work.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For BaZi weak organs (e.g., weak Earth spleen, weak Water kidney), pair stem/branch diagnosis with corresponding 黄庭 palace visualization. 2) Practice short daily 存思 of the relevant palace rather than only general 'calm.' 3) When charts show scattered 神 (many 食伤, restless Fire), use the text's logic: call spirits home before seeking power. 4) Recite or silently name palace spirits to stabilize attention. 5) Never force sexual or aggressive alchemy without prior inner-landscape literacy.
entries.logic_compare: More imaginal-anatomical than 导引养生经's physical daoyin and than 胎息经's pure breath. Differs from 存神炼气铭 by being scriptural-poetic and palace-dense rather than short inscription-style method. Versus 入药镜, it maps the house; the latter times the drug.

entries.logic_thesis: The inscription proves that spirit and qi are co-dependent variables: lose spirit and qi scatters; deplete qi and spirit cannot stay. Immortality practice therefore collapses to one dual operation—hold the spirit still while refining the qi pure—rather than a catalog of many techniques. Brevity itself argues that the method is simple in principle and absolute in requirement.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Spirit is the master; qi is the servant and vehicle. 2) If spirit wanders, qi has no governor and leaks. 3) If qi is coarse or exhausted, spirit has no seat. 4) Hence simultaneous 存神 and 炼气 is the minimal sufficient practice. 5) Ancillary arts fail when this dual core is missing. 6) Conclusion: dual cultivation of stillness-of-spirit and purity-of-qi is the efficient cause of extended life.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In daily practice, measure sessions by 'spirit stayed / qi warmed,' not minutes alone. 2) For BaZi day-masters weak with strong output, prioritize 存神 (attention hygiene) over stimulants. 3) For strong day-masters with clogged 印, emphasize gentle 炼气 over more mental effort. 4) When illness years hit, return to this dual core before complex protocols. 5) Teach: eyes, breath, and intent as one triangle implementing the铭.
entries.logic_compare: Shorter and more method-pure than 养性延命录's anthology. Less landscape-detailed than 黄庭, less sexual-alchemical than some Zhong-Lü materials. Differs from 了心经 by working psychophysical qi, not only cognitive cessation of mind-objects.

entries.logic_thesis: Tao Hongjing's compilation proves that extending life is an empirical, multi-source craft: diet, sleep, sex, daoyin, breath, and seasonal living are convergent causes that can be ranked and combined. No single secret replaces the accumulation of correct micro-habits; nature (性) is preserved by eliminating the many small deaths of excess. Longevity is argued as engineering of daily causality.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Lifespan shortens by identifiable excesses and deficits. 2) Ancients recorded partial remedies across schools. 3) Collecting and ordering them yields a practical system. 4) System works because each factor is causal, not symbolic only. 5) Therefore anthology + discrimination beats sectarian monopoly. 6) Conclusion: cultivate nature by managing the full lifestyle matrix.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build a BaZi health plan as a matrix: sleep, food, sex, motion, emotion—score each against chart weaknesses. 2) Prefer subtracting excess (alcohol, late nights, rage) before adding exotic practice. 3) Season-adjust advice using the text's calendrical hygiene. 4) For 食伤-heavy charts, regulate speech and stimulation as lifespan tech. 5) Treat the record as experimental: test one variable for 49 days, then next.
entries.logic_compare: More medical-encyclopedic than Laojun's short 养生诀, more secular-hygienic than 盟威箓's ritual law. Unlike 钟吕传道集's staged internal alchemy curriculum, it stays mostly pre-neidan and multi-modal. It differs from 胎息经 by refusing breath monopoly.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that bondage is cognitive: the mind manufactures objects, attachments, and identities that then appear as external fate. 'Finishing the mind' (了心) is liberation because when mind-objects cease to bind, neither demon nor destiny has a handle. Cultivation's highest lever is therefore insight into mind's constructive activity, not only qi manipulation.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Suffering and obstruction arise where mind clings and discriminates. 2) Clinging is not forced by heaven; it is mind's habit. 3) Seeing this habit through dissolves its necessity. 4) Dissolved habit leaves spirit free and responsive. 5) Free spirit no longer generates self-inflicted calamity. 6) Conclusion: awakening to mind's emptiness of fixed objects is the root soteriology.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When BaZi shows repeating disaster patterns, first audit the mental story that re-enacts them. 2) Use short 了心 checks: 'Who is anxious? What object is grasped?' before ritual fixes. 3) For strong 比劫/ego charts, prioritize mind-seeing over more competitive striving. 4) Pair with breath only after a moment of cognitive release. 5) Teach clients: luck changes when the interpreter of luck changes.
entries.logic_compare: Closer to Buddhist-flavored mind doctrine than 阴符经's strategy of heaven-man theft. Differs from 存神炼气铭 by targeting cognitive objects more than qi purity. Unlike 想尔注's moral commandments, 了心经 argues freedom through epistemic shift, not mainly through precept.

entries.logic_thesis: Yinfu Jing proves that the universe runs on a stealable, concealable mechanism: the sage who observes and appropriates the same generative-destructive processes that drive heaven and earth gains power without opposing the Dao. Human agency is legitimate when it mirrors cosmic timing and predation-as-transformation; blindness to the mechanism is the only true weakness. Strategy and spirituality thus share one logic of insight into process.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Heaven and earth have a hidden operating pattern (阴符). 2) The myriad things are produced and slain by that pattern. 3) The sage's eye can read and enact the pattern. 4) Enacting it 'steals' the creative-killing function for cultivation and governance. 5) Those who only moralize without reading mechanism remain prey. 6) Conclusion: profound observation of process equals power.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, treat luck pillars as 阴符 windows: act with the season of the chart, not against it. 2) Map 'kill and give life' to 官杀 and 印: pressure transforms into resource when timed. 3) Practice observing one natural process daily (rise/fall of energy) as training for reading fate. 4) For 七杀 charts, reframe killing qi as usable mechanism, not pure doom. 5) Conceal intent: strategic quiet beats loud force when mechanism is understood.
entries.logic_compare: More martial-strategic and cryptic than hygienic 养生 texts. Unlike 道德经's soft yielding emphasis in many readings, 阴符 stresses predatory insight and timing. Differs from 入药镜 by speaking cosmic strategy more than staged drug-fire details of neidan.

entries.logic_thesis: Ruyao Jing proves that internal alchemy can be compressed into a mirror-like set of correspondences: when to gather the 'medicine,' how fire phases rise and fall, and what errors scatter the elixir. The body-time complex is argued as a precise craft of intake and cookery; without correct timing and measure, effort is counterfeit. Clarity of formula is itself the soteriological claim.
entries.logic_chain: 1) True medicine arises at specific internal-temporal conditions. 2) Fire (intent/breath intensity) must match the stage. 3) Wrong timing or excess fire damages jing and scatters qi. 4) Correct sequence crystallizes the elixir. 5) A 'mirror' text exists to check practice against known marks. 6) Conclusion: verified stage-markers make immortality a disciplined technology.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Never force 'gather medicine' in BaZi death-phase years without checking vitality signs. 2) Use the text's markers (warmth, stillness, light) as pass/fail for sessions. 3) For weak day-masters, keep fire low (gentle intent); for stagnant strong charts, carefully raise circulation—not aggression. 4) Log lunar/clock timing against subjective medicine arising. 5) Treat sexual loss and anger as breaking the mirror—immediate stop and repair.
entries.logic_compare: More formulaic and stage-sensitive than 阴符经's abstract strategy. Shorter and denser than 钟吕传道集's dialogue curriculum. Differs from 胎息经 by emphasizing drug-and-fire language over fetal breathing alone.

entries.logic_thesis: The text proves that ordinary mouth-nose breathing is a fallen, leaky mode, while return to embryonic respiration—qi circulating without coarse panting—restores the prenatal condition of life. Breath is the master variable: master the subtle breath and the spirit stabilizes; fail it and all other arts rest on a cracked foundation. Immortality is argued as reversion of respiratory ontology.
entries.logic_chain: 1) The fetus lives by internal qi without external gasping. 2) Birth establishes leaky external breathing and gradual decline. 3) Training can reverse breathing toward embryonic subtlety. 4) Subtle breath retains jing and calms spirit. 5) Retention enables higher spirit-work and longevity. 6) Conclusion: fetal breathing is the root technique of reversion.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build practice on lengthening, softening, and eventually 'closing' coarse breath before complex visualizations. 2) For BaZi 气虚 patterns (weak 印, exhausted 劫), prioritize 胎息 over intense movement. 3) Use lower-abdomen awareness as the 'womb' seat of breath. 4) Stop practice if breath becomes forced—force is anti-embryonic. 5) Pair sleep hygiene with 胎息: night repair as prenatal return.
entries.logic_compare: More mono-causal (breath-rooted) than 养性延命录's multi-factor hygiene. Less palace-visualization than 黄庭, less cosmological strategy than 阴符. Unlike 存神炼气铭's dual slogan, 胎息经 elaborates the breath pole as the royal road.

entries.name_han: 秘传正阳真人灵宝毕法
entries.logic_thesis: Lingbao Bifa proves that the complete path can be ordered as a graded curriculum from human to immortal, with each stage having prerequisites, methods, and verification signs. Random eclecticism fails because higher 'fires' applied to unprepared 'medicine' destroy the vessel; sequence is therefore not pedagogy alone but physical-spiritual safety logic. Completion (毕) means finishing the ladder, not collecting techniques.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Transformation of body-spirit has discrete stages. 2) Each stage produces a new capacity and a new vulnerability. 3) Skipping stages misapplies method to unready material. 4) A complete method text must list order, time, and proofs. 5) Zhong-Lü style sequencing integrates earlier arts under one ladder. 6) Conclusion: graded completion is the rational structure of immortality practice.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Diagnose the client's/current stage before recommending 入药 or advanced fire. 2) Use BaZi vitality and age cycles as rough stage-gates (don't force late-stage work on depleted charts). 3) Demand verification signs before 'promotion' in practice. 4) Keep a written ladder: hygiene → breath → gather → cook → transcend. 5) When stuck, step down one stage rather than adding exotic methods.
entries.logic_compare: More systematically staged than 入药镜's compact mirror and than 胎息经's single root. Closely related to 钟吕传道集 but more 'method manual' than dialogue. Differs from early Tianshi 科戒 by being alchemical-interior rather than communal-legal.

entries.logic_thesis: This dialogue proves that true transmission occurs when doubts are systematically dismantled and the disciple's worldview is rebuilt around yin-yang, five phases, and the body as crucible. Zhong-Lü authority rests on reasoned Q&A: alchemy is teachable because it answers why each step must be so. Oral-style dialectic is thus argued as the proper form of high Daoist pedagogy.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Disciples fail from partial hearing and wrong questions. 2) Masters must expose false paths (mere quietism, crude sexual arts, empty ritual). 3) Correct cosmology (Heaven-Earth-Man, time-fire) grounds correct practice. 4) Dialogue tests understanding before empowering method. 5) Shared Zhong-Lü framework unifies scattered techniques. 6) Conclusion: reasoned transmission prevents fatal error better than secret slogans alone.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Teach BaZi/neidan by question-driven correction, not monologue dumps. 2) Explicitly refute the client's likely false path (only meditation / only talismans / only supplements). 3) Ground every timing advice in yin-yang five-phase causality visible in the chart. 4) Require the student to restate the 'why' of a method before practicing. 5) Use the text's topics as a syllabus checklist for complete training.
entries.logic_compare: Dialogical and comprehensive versus 入药镜's terse formulas and 毕法's stepwise manual tone. More neidan-interior than 太平经's social utopia. Differs from 广圣义 by building a practice cosmology rather than commentarial expansion of Laozi verse.

entries.logic_thesis: Xiang'er proves that the Daodejing can be read as a concrete code of life-extension and communal orthodoxy: 'Dao' becomes a personal-celestial power that rewards purity, restraint, and correct worship while punishing deviation. Philosophical ambiguity is deliberately closed into actionable 戒; commentary is thus a political-soteriological instrument. Longevity and social order are argued as fruits of obeying a moralized Laozi.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Laozi's verses can be interpreted many ways. 2) The Xiang'er lineage selects readings that bind conduct and ritual. 3) Binding readings produce clear rewards and punishments from Dao. 4) Community that follows them gains life and stability. 5) Rival readings that license license or empty speculation are rejected. 6) Conclusion: orthopractic commentary is the true activation of the classic.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When citing 道德经 in BaZi counsel, prefer actionable virtue (less desire, less cunning speech) over aesthetic paradox. 2) Link chart disasters to specific conduct breaches the Xiang'er would name. 3) Use 'Dao watches' as a discipline frame for clients who only want techniques. 4) Prioritize sexual and dietary restraint as textual, not merely medical, duty. 5) Build family rules from commentarial precepts, not only from luck pillars.
entries.logic_compare: More moralizing and Tianshi-aligned than philosophical Laozi readings and than 关尹子's speculative mysticism. Differs from 广圣义 by being early, terse, and disciplinary rather than Tang-era encyclopedic exegesis. Unlike 化胡经, its aim is internal community rule, not external religious competition narrative.

entries.logic_thesis: Huahu Jing proves (within its polemical frame) that Daoist authority is historically prior and universally missionizing: Laozi's westward transformation of the barbarians explains rival teachings as derivative pedagogy. Religious legitimacy is argued through narrative of origin and conversion, not only through inner cultivation results. Hierarchy of teachings is therefore a historical-logical claim.
entries.logic_chain: 1) If Laozi is the source sage who civilizes all directions, later foreign doctrines are partial echoes. 2) Narrative of 化胡 supplies that source relation. 3) Source relation implies superior completeness of Daoist method. 4) Communities use the narrative to justify ranking and conversion. 5) Contested historicity does not cancel the text's internal logic of priority. 6) Conclusion: mission myth functions as an argument for doctrinal supremacy.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In comparative religion work, separate the text's polemical logic from empirical history before teaching. 2) Use the 'skillful means for different peoples' idea carefully: adapt teaching form without contempt. 3) For BaZi cross-cultural clients, prioritize universal cultivation laws over identity contests. 4) Study the text to understand how Daoist institutions once argued authority—then avoid crude supremacy in modern practice. 5) Extract only the usable kernel: one Dao, many pedagogical languages.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike 想尔注's inward precept commentary, 化胡经 is outward and competitive. Differs from 玉枢宝经's inclusive salvific prayer by ranking traditions. Versus 钟吕传道集, it barely cares about internal stage-craft; its battlefield is origin story and legitimacy.

entries.logic_thesis: Guangshengyi proves that the Daodejing's authority expands, rather than dilutes, when layered with imperial, commentarial, and scholastic meanings: a short classic can govern politics, cosmology, and cultivation if exegesis is vast enough. Breadth of interpretation is argued as fidelity to an inexhaustible source text. Sacred sense is therefore cumulative and institutional, not only private insight.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Laozi is brief and polyvalent. 2) Sage-kings and masters have drawn successive valid layers. 3) Collecting those layers (广) serves both state and salvation. 4) A 'holy meaning' frame unifies layers under orthodox Daoism. 5) Readers gain a map from politics down to body practice. 6) Conclusion: expansive commentary is a technology of totalizing the classic's use.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When a BaZi or life problem seems only personal, check political-social layers of Dao (timing of office, speech, non-contention). 2) Use multi-level reading: one verse → body, family, state analogies. 3) Avoid reducing Laozi to a single self-help slogan; hold several valid applications. 4) Teach advanced students to cite commentarial lineages, not only gut feel. 5) For cultivation, pull 无为 as both mental non-forcing and strategic non-overreach in luck use.
entries.logic_compare: Opposite operation to 太平经钞: expansion versus compression. More scholastic-imperial than 想尔注's early disciplinary bite. Differs from 关尹子 by remaining tethered to Laozi's chapter structure rather than free speculative chapters.

entries.logic_thesis: Guan Yinzi proves that ultimate reality is approachable through radical fluidity: things, selves, and distinctions are provisional transformations within one Dao, so liberation is cognitive-ontological flexibility rather than accumulation of fixed techniques. Paradox and image dissolve rigid causality just enough to free the sage's response. Wisdom is argued as unblocked transformation-awareness.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Fixed names and dualisms freeze the mind. 2) The world itself is endless transformation without hard edges. 3) Matching mind to that fluidity ends fearful grasping. 4) Unbound mind acts with spontaneous appropriateness. 5) Techniques serve only if they don't re-freeze the mind into dogma. 6) Conclusion: metaphysical fluidity is practical freedom.
entries.logic_practice: 1) When BaZi readings become fatalistic prisons, use 关尹子 logic to reopen multiple skillful responses. 2) Practice seeing one event under several five-phase descriptions without panic. 3) For rigid 官杀 charts/personalities, prescribe contemplations on transformation and non-fixity. 4) Drop methods that have become identity armor. 5) Alternate precision practice (breath, stages) with periods of open, imageless resting.
entries.logic_compare: More free-speculative and literary-philosophical than Tianshi codes and than Zhong-Lü stage manuals. Differs from 了心经 by broader ontological play, not only mind-object cessation. Unlike 阴符经's hard strategic mechanism, 关尹子 softens mechanism into metamorphosis.

entries.name_han: 九天应元雷声普化天尊玉枢宝经
entries.logic_thesis: Yushu Baojing proves that cosmic rectification can be petitioned and enacted through the Thunder hierarchy: sincere recitation and alignment with 雷声普化 authority mobilize purifying force against disaster, injustice, and demonic obstruction. Salvation is not only slow self-alchemy but also responsive celestial power when the adept's mind matches the scripture's vow-structure. Universal transformation (普化) is argued as available efficacy under correct invocation.
entries.logic_chain: 1) The Thunder offices administer punishment and renewal in the cosmos. 2) Humans suffer when demonic or disordered forces prevail unchecked. 3) Scripture and deity name open a lawful channel to those offices. 4) Sincerity, purity, and correct recitation complete the channel. 5) Resulting power purifies calamity and aids conversion of beings. 6) Conclusion: liturgical alignment with Thunder authority is a valid soteriological causality alongside personal cultivation.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For BaZi years of sudden shock, legal danger, or 'thunder' imagery (strong 伤官见官, severe 七杀), combine conduct purification with scripture recitation—not recitation alone. 2) Use the text when clients face acute crisis needing courage and clarity, after ethics check. 3) Morning recitation as mind-alignment before strategic action. 4) Never treat Thunder rites as substitutes for stopping harm one is causing. 5) Pair with community merit and restitution when the chart shows debt-like patterns.
entries.logic_compare: Liturgical and theistic-responsive versus neidan texts' internal furnace logic. Differs from 盟威箓 by being more universally recitable scripture than exclusive register initiation (though still hierarchical). Unlike 太平经's reform program, it centers Thunder deity efficacy and purification rather than full socio-economic redesign.
